items.title: The farmer's year, in outline

seasons.spring: Sow, mend the hurdles, the reeve walks the lines from the Hanging Stone.
seasons.summer: Weed, haymaking, the fair. The rival's bench is at the fair too.
seasons.autumn: The harvest gamble, the rent, the lender's man on the field edge.
seasons.winter: The hearth, the stores, the hard winter when the diet is thin.

openQuestions: Does the reeve belong to the lord or to the village? The engine has no reeve yet; v0.71 decides.
How many strips make a field worth keeping?
